## Definition of Done

- [ ] Implementation complete and acceptance criteria met
- [ ] Tests added or updated; lint, type-check and build pass locally
- [ ] Documentation updated if setup, architecture or operations changed
- [ ] No secrets, credentials or personal data (names, emails, IDs) in code, fixtures or logs
- [ ] No known High/Critical security issue introduced
- [ ] Primary and support owners requested for review
- [ ] Diff is small enough to review (~400 lines); if not, explain why above
